Test Case Description: Hero shows the promise, two actions and a live example score from the engine
Preconditions: Website open in Chrome at /, fresh browser storage (example household), currency INR
Test Data: Example household (built in): income ₹1,00,000, spending ₹60,000, EMIs ₹15,000, fund ₹2,25,000
Steps:
1. Open /
2. Read the hero headline and the sentence under it
3. Look at the two buttons
4. Read the example card
5. Read the three figures and the top priority
6. Count the trust points; read the browser console
Expected Result:
1. The home page opens with one h1
2. Headline "Know your money's health in two minutes." and "Nothing you type leaves your device."
3. "Start free health check" (primary) and "See all calculators" (secondary)
4. Card "Example household · Live engine" with the ring "Score 75 out of 100, Good", grade Good and "Keeps ₹25,000 a month"
5. Savings rate 25 %, Emergency fund 3.0 mo, Loan payments 15 %; "Top priority · +10 pts Build your emergency fund"
6. 4 trust points incl. "No login, no bank link" and "Pro from ₹17 a month"; no console errors
